hooks.name: Clover Security
hooks.description: Clover reviews the plan/prompt before implementation. This is a demo probe: it records that the hook fired; production Clover posts to the Clover backend.

action.command: bash -c 'printf "[Clover Security] UserPromptSubmit fired at %s\n" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> /tmp/clover-security-hook.log; IFS= read -r -t 1 -d "" ctx; printf "%s\n" "$ctx" >> /tmp/clover-security-hook-stdin.log; exit 0'
